# Remepy Raises $36 Million Series A To Advance Hybridopa Phase III And Hybrid Drug Pipeline
Remepy has raised $36 million in Series A funding to expand its Hybrid Drug pipeline, accelerate pharmaceutical partnerships, and fund global Phase III development of Hybridopa for Parkinson’s disease.
The financing brings the company’s total capital raised to $62 million. O.G. Venture Partners and M Ventures, the strategic venture arm of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, led the round.
Investors also included NFX, Vine Ventures, Qumra Capital, TechAviv, 97212 Ventures, Fresh Fund, PsyMed Ventures, Tadmor Group, Key1 Capital, and IT-Farm.

# Remepy Raises $36M in Series A Funding
**[Remepy](https://www.remepy.com/)** , a NYC-based provider of a platform for hybrid drugs that combine prescription medicines with personalized, AI-driven therapeutic apps, raised $36M in Series A funding.
The round was led by O.G. Venture Partners and M Ventures, with participation from existing and new investors including NFX, Vine Ventures, Qumra Capital, TechAviv, 97212 Ventures, Fresh Fund, PsyMed Ventures, Tadmor Group, Key1 Capital, and IT-Farm Corp.
The raise brought the total amount to $62M.
The company intends to use the funds to accelerate its pharmaceutical co-development partnerships, expand its Hybrid Drug pipeline and platform, and fund the global Phase III clinical development of Hybridopa, its lead program for Parkinson’s disease.

Remepy raises $36 million in Series A Remepy has announced the closing of a $36 million Series A financing round led by O.G. Venture Partners and M Ventures, the corporate strategic venture arm of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, with participation from existing and new investors including NFX, Vine Ventures, Qumra Capital, TechAviv, 97212 Ventures, Fresh Fund, PsyMed Ventures, Tadmor Group, Key1 Capital, and IT-Farm Corp.4 The round brings total capital raised by the company to $62 million. The proceeds are expected to accelerate Remepy's pharmaceutical co-development partnerships and the expansion of its Hybrid Drug pipeline and platform, as well as fund the global Phase III clinical development of Hybridopa, the company's lead program for Parkinson's disease.5 Remepy partners with pharmaceutical companies to develop Hybrid Drugs, a class of treatment that combines prescription medicines with personalized, AI-driven therapeutic apps, integrating pharmacology with adaptive physical, cognitive and behavioral interventions into a single treatment delivered through the standard prescription model.4 The Hybrid Drug model is supported by emerging FDA frameworks for drug-software combination products and is gaining industry momentum, according to the company.5 "We believe medicine is entering a new era, where every breakthrough drug will be paired with personalized intelligence to maximize its impact for every patient," said Michal Tsur, PhD, and Or Shoval, co-chief executive officers of Remepy.
